title: Game Roster
body:
Goal: use composition: a Game object HAS a list of Player objects and asks them to do things.

  1. Open starter.py in Thonny. Player is done. Read it first.
  2. Finish the TODOs in Game: add_player, give_points, leader and still_playing.
  3. Press Run. You should see:
Space Race: 3 players
Leader: Comet
Still playing: ['Comet', 'Nova']

Extra: add a method scoreboard(self) that returns a list of lines like "Comet: 50 points, 3 lives".

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Read Player first, since it is done. A Game keeps a list called self.players, and your TODOs all use that list. The method find is also done, and it can help you in give_points.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: To make a new object, call the class like a function: Player(...). Then .append() puts it in the list. For leader, keep a running "best so far" while you loop. At the start, there is no best yet, so it is None. Check for that.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: In add_player, make the player, self.players.append(____), then return ____. In give_points, use self.find(____) and check is not None. In leader, check if best is None or ____ > ____:. In still_playing, test if not ____.is_out():.

starter.name: starter.py
starter.html: # Game Roster - YOUR version # Composition: a Game HAS A list of Player objects. # (Inheritance is "IS A"; composition is "HAS A".) # Finish the TODOs, then press Run and see if it does what the README says. class Player: """One player in the game, known by a nickname. (Already done!)""" def __init__(self, nickname): self.nickname = nickname self.score = 0 self.lives = 3 def add_points(self, points): self.score = self.score + points def lose_life(self): if self.lives > 0: self.lives = self.lives - 1 def is_out(self): return self.lives == 0 class Game: """A game that keeps a list of Player objects.""" def __init__(self, title): self.title = title self.players = [] # the Game HAS players def add_player(self, nickname): """Make a new Player, keep it in the list, and return it.""" # TODO 1: make Player(nickname), append it to self.players, return it return None def find(self, nickname): """Return the Player with this nickname, or None. (Already done!)""" for player in self.players: if player.nickname == nickname: return player return None def give_points(self, nickname, points): # TODO 2: find the player; if it is not None, call its add_points pass def leader(self): """Return the Player with the highest score (None if no players).""" best = None # TODO 3: loop over self.players; keep the one with the biggest score return best def still_playing(self): """Return a list of the players who still have lives.""" playing = [] # TODO 4: append every player whose is_out() is False return playing if __name__ == "__main__": game = Game("Space Race") for nickname in ["StarFox", "Comet", "Nova"]: game.add_player(nickname) game.give_points("Comet", 50) game.give_points("Nova", 30) if game.find("StarFox") is not None: for _ in range(3): game.find("StarFox").lose_life() print(f"{game.title}: {len(game.players)} players") if game.leader() is not None: print("Leader:", game.leader().nickname) print("Still playing:", [p.nickname for p in game.still_playing()])
